name: Backyard Comedy Club
address: 231 Cambridge Heath Rd, Bethnal Green, London
summary: A purpose-built comedy club on Cambridge Heath Road. It says it is the largest of its kind in London.

accessibility.notes: Guide dogs are allowed in the auditorium; other dogs only in the bar. The club does not take incoming calls, so contact the venue before buying if you are unsure about access.

cost.notes: Show tickets are priced by night in advance (for example £7.50 on Thursdays and £16 on Saturdays, plus a booking fee); door tickets cost more where available. No concession tickets.

age_policy: Evening shows are 18+; a challenge 25 ID policy applies.

evidence.quote: We are the largest professional, purpose built comedy club in London
there are no steps, our venue is all on one level, and we have wide doorways for easy access.
Dogs are welcome in our bar area but we do not allow any dogs in the auditorium for shows.
The only exception is Guide dogs for assisting any Blind Customers.
Unfortunately we do not take incoming calls.
If in any doubt please contact the venue before purchase to discuss.
We do not do a concession price ticket
All our evening shows are over 18s.
We also operate a challenge 25 policy
Backyard Comedy Club, 231 Cambridge Heath Rd, Bethnal Green, E2 0EL
since 2013, they've also hosted variety shows, cabaret, swing dancing and more.
run by British stand-up Lee Hurst, star of 'They Think it's All Over', who you can occasionally find performing here.
